# Menu and tasting menus in Vic

A changing menu shaped by seasonal ingredients and what arrives in our kitchen each day. À la carte dishes, our Pica-Pica selection and sharing menus, prepared with care and respect for the ingredients.

[Book a table](https://reservviarestaurant.cat/es/?lang=en) [View the menu](https://viarestaurant.cat/es/menu-via-restaurant-vic/#menu-1)

## Nico’s tasting menu

Whole table only

Forget the à la carte menu and enjoy VIA. Every day, Nico creates a unique menu with the finest seasonal ingredients, freshly arrived in our kitchen.

Price €100 · VAT included

Drinks not included.

## VIA’s Pica-Pica

Whole table only

- Bouchot mussels
- Galician razor clam
- Galician cockle
- Grilled Daniel Sorlut spéciale No. 2 oyster
- Andalusian-style anchovies
- Grilled striped prawn
- Grilled langoustine
- Grilled squid
- Fish of the day
- Sourdough bread

Price €65 · VAT included

Drinks not included.

## Fontcuberta Menu

Whole table only

To share

- Homemade croquettes, two varieties
- Stuffed courgette flower
- Garlic king prawn
- Andalusian-style squid

Choice of main course

- XL slow-cooked beef cannelloni
- Charcoal-grilled duck breast
- Confit cod with samfaina
- Monkfish tail from the coast — €10 supplement
- Wagyu fillet from Tavertet — €15 supplement

Dessert and sourdough bread.

Price €55 · VAT included

Drinks not included.

## À la carte

### Fresh fish and seafood

- Daniel Sorlut spéciale No. 2 oyster
- Bouchot mussels
- XL Galician cockles
- XL fine clams from Carril, Galicia
- Sea cucumbers from Llançà
- Andalusian-style baby squid from the coast
- Baby cuttlefish from the coast
- Confit Icelandic cod loin with samfaina
- John Dory from the coast
- Scorpionfish from the coast
- Turbot from the coast
- Whole monkfish from the coast
- XL langoustines
- Red prawn from Palamós
- Carabinero prawn from Huelva

### Croquettes

- Slow-cooked beef croquette
- Cod croquette
- Cep mushroom croquette
- Wagyu croquette from Tavertet
- Carabinero prawn croquette from Huelva
- Red prawn croquette

### Suggestions

- Vic cured sausage by Casa Riera Ordeix 1852
- 100% Iberian ham, D.O. Guijuelo
- Cantabrian anchovies
- Foie micuit with a touch of Pedro Ximénez and caramelised apple
- Icelandic cod carpaccio with tomato tartare and olive tapenade
- A5 wagyu ribeye carpaccio with Parmesan, local pine nuts and Pedro Ximénez reduction
- Red prawn tartare with prawn cream and Calvisius caviar
- Scallop with sea urchin and Calvisius caviar on scallop cream
- Open omelette with ceps and confit pancetta
- XL fish and seafood cannelloni

### Meats

- Slow-cooked Segovia suckling pig
- House-confit Collverd duck leg with ratafia reduction and nuts
- Kid goat shoulder
- Slow-cooked lamb shoulder
- Slow-cooked Angus beef
- Wagyu from Tavertet
- Grilled wagyu fillet from Tavertet
- Certified Japanese A5 wagyu
- Grilled A5 wagyu fillet

### Rice dishes

Served only in paella pans for two guests. Price per person.

- Rice with sea cucumbers from Llançà
- Rice with Palamós red prawn
- Rice with XL langoustine
- Rice with Huelva carabinero prawn
- Seasonal rice
- Black rice with squid and striped prawn

### Desserts

All desserts are made at VIA by our chef. Most are prepared to order.

- Warm cheesecake made to order — 25 minutes
- Valrhona Guanaja 70% chocolate coulant made to order — 25 minutes
- Apple tarte Tatin made to order
- Madagascar vanilla flan
- “La Llimona”
- Please ask for today’s desserts

Menu items may vary according to the season and product availability. If you have any allergy or intolerance, please inform our team before ordering: we will provide details of the allergens present in our dishes.

VIA Restaurant

# Gastronomic restaurant in Vic

Seasonal cooking at Casa Fontcuberta. Fine ingredients, thoughtful cooking and time to enjoy your meal.

[Book a table](https://reservviarestaurant.cat/es/?lang=en) [View the menu](https://viarestaurant.cat/es/menu-via-restaurant-vic/)

Ingredients, setting and craft

## A house with a character of its own

At VIA, our menu follows the market: fresh fish and seafood, carefully chosen meats, vegetables, mushrooms and truffles in season. Straightforward cooking that respects the flavour of each ingredient.

You will find us on the noble floor of Casa Fontcuberta, a listed historic house in the centre of Vic. Wall paintings, chandeliers and carefully set tables give the dining room its character, inviting you to take your time over our cooking.

[The chef](https://viarestaurant.cat/es/chef-nico-via-restaurant-vic/)

![Casa Fontcuberta’s grand dining room, with set tables, wall paintings and chandeliers](https://viarestaurant.cat/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/via-nova-sala1-960.webp)

The rhythm of the seasons

## Led by the ingredients

Mushrooms, truffles, fish from the coast and market produce. Each season has its moment in our kitchen.

In the centre of Vic

## Casa Fontcuberta, Carrer de la Riera

Carrer de la Riera, 25

First floor, noble floor · 08500 Vic (Barcelona)

The restaurant is at Carrer de la Riera, 25, on the first-floor noble level of Casa Fontcuberta, a listed historic house near Plaça Major. Vehicle access to the historic centre is restricted: we recommend leaving your car in one of the marked car parks and completing the journey on foot.

[Get directions](https://goo.gl/maps/LTTWye8BJoBbXhNC6)
